name: Trace a delayed bag
title: Trace a bag that never arrived and send it to the house
summary: A Belfast shift worker reports a case that did not come off the belt. He pauses twice while reading the tag off a sticker, the trace takes a while, his street needs spelling and he only says 'the end of the week' for delivery. If the agent mishears the tag or postcode, or picks a day for him, he corrects it once or twice and then gives up.

golden.scenario: Caller's hold bag did not arrive last night. They want it traced and delivered to their home.
golden.expected_outcome: Bag tag XJ407716 is captured across both pauses and traced on booking H9W3LP. The agent confirms the spelling of Cregagh Mews and the postcode BT6 9EQ before saving the address. The agent pins 'the end of the week' down to Friday 14 August, after midday, instead of choosing a day. The agent reads the report reference BHD20618 back character by character.

outcome_checks: Bag tag XJ407716 is captured across both pauses and traced on booking H9W3LP.
